/-! ### PROBE 5: the `R'`-ALGEBRA face and the quotient transport -/

/-- PROBE: the `R'`-algebra face of the widened keystone: `R' ⊗[R] Γ(V) ≃ₐ[R'] Γ(V')`.
Flip the tensor factors and read `R'`-linearity off `pieceRingEquiv_one_tmul`, exactly the
role `relTermBaseChangeAlg` plays in the chart-typed layer — but for an arbitrary affine
open. -/
noncomputable def probe_pieceTermBaseChangeAff {V : (relCurve C R).Opens}
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, V) ≃ₐ[R']
      Γ(relCurve C R', relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
  AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv
    (f := (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R R' Γ(relCurve C R, V)).toRingEquiv.trans
      (Over.pieceRingEquiv (A := R) (B := R') C hV))
    (fun r' => by
      show Over.pieceRingEquiv (A := R) (B := R') C hV
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R R' Γ(relCurve C R, V)
            (algebraMap R' (R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, V)) r')) = _
      rw [show algebraMap R' (R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, V)) r' = r' ⊗ₜ[R] 1 from rfl,
        Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul, Over.pieceRingEquiv_one_tmul]
      rfl)

@[simp]
theorem probe_pieceTermBaseChangeAff_one_tmul {V : (relCurve C R).Opens}
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (s : Γ(relCurve C R, V)) :
    probe_pieceTermBaseChangeAff C R' hV ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s) =
      ((relCurveMap C R R').appLE V (relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl).hom s := by
  show Over.pieceRingEquiv (A := R) (B := R') C hV
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R R' Γ(relCurve C R, V) ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s)) = _
  rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul, Over.pieceRingEquiv_tmul_one]

    (f := (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R R' Γ(relCurve C R, V)).toRingEquiv.trans
      (Over.pieceRingEquiv (A := R) (B := R') C hV))
    (fun r' => by
      show Over.pieceRingEquiv (A := R) (B := R') C hV
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R R' Γ(relCurve C R, V)
            (algebraMap R' (R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, V)) r')) = _
      rw [show algebraMap R' (R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, V)) r' = r' ⊗ₜ[R] 1 from rfl,
        Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul, Over.pieceRingEquiv_one_tmul]

theorem probe_pieceTermBaseChangeAff_one_tmul {V : (relCurve C R).Opens}
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (s : Γ(relCurve C R, V)) :
    probe_pieceTermBaseChangeAff C R' hV ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s) =

    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (E : Set Γ(relCurve C R, V)) :
    R' ⊗[R] (Γ(relCurve C R, V) ⧸ Ideal.span E) ≃ₐ[R']

      (by
        rw [Ideal.map_span, Ideal.map_span, ← Set.image_comp]
        exact congrArg Ideal.span (Set.image_congr fun s _ =>
          (probe_pieceTermBaseChangeAff_one_tmul C R' hV s).symm)))

    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (E : Set Γ(relCurve C R, V)) (s : Γ(relCurve C R, V)) :

namespace AffCoverData

/-- **The widened cover from a straddling affine open plus a cover of the rest.** `W` is the
affine open containing the support (the Stacks `0B8B` piece); `Ws` is any finite family of
affine opens which, together with `W`, covers the curve.  The straddling condition itself is

noncomputable def ofSwallowingPiece (W : (relCurve C R).Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    {m : ℕ} (Ws : Fin m → (relCurve C R).Opens) (hWs : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (Ws i))

  m := m + 1
  pieces := Fin.snoc Ws W

/-- PROBE: the raw pushout square of section rings for an ARBITRARY affine open `V` of
`relCurve C R` (no chart, no basic open, no partition of unity). -/
theorem probe_isPushout_relSections {V : (relCurve C R).Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    IsPushout
      ((snd C (overSpec k R)).left.appLE ⊤ V
        (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k R)).left).ge))
      ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R'))).appLE ⊤ ⊤
        (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R')))).ge)
      ((relCurveMap C R R').appLE V (relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl)
      ((snd C (overSpec k R')).left.appLE ⊤ (relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V)
        (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k R')).left).ge)) := by
  have hUST : (⊤ : (overSpec k R').left.Opens) ≤
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R')) ⁻¹ᵁ
        (⊤ : (overSpec k R).left.Opens) :=
    (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top _).ge
  have hUSX : V ≤ (snd C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (overSpec k R).left.Opens) :=
    le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top _).ge
  have hUY : relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V =
      relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓
        (snd C (overSpec k R')).left ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (overSpec k R').left.Opens) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top, inf_top_eq]

    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :

      ((relCurveMap C R R').appLE V (relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl)

    exact (Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc _ _).symm

    IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R S) := by

    exact IsOpenImmersion.of_isLocalization f

/-- **`cg`-saturated affine opens form a basis.** Every neighbourhood `V` of a point `x` of
the curve product `C ⊗ Spec A` contains an affine open `W` with `x ∈ W` whose `cg`-preimage

This packages the geometric pieces for the downstream covering arguments of E3. -/

/-- **The curve product over a proper `C` is a separated scheme.** `C.hom` is separated (`C`
proper over the field `k`), hence so is its base change `pA = snd`; composing with the affine

separated.  This supplies the affine-diagonal instance the intersection lemma needs. -/

  constructor
  haveI : IsSeparated (snd C (overSpec k A)).left :=
    MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (Over.isPullback_left C (overSpec k A)) inferInstance
  haveI : IsSeparated ((C ⊗ overSpec k A).hom) := by

    infer_instance

  infer_instance

/-- **The affine opens of the curve product are closed under intersection** (for `C` proper
over the field `k`).  The intersection of two affine opens of the separated scheme
`C ⊗ Spec A` is affine (`IsAffineOpen.inf`, via the affine diagonal of a separated scheme), so
the `cg`-saturated affine family of `exists_isAffineOpen_cg_le` carries the overlaps
`W = V ⊓ V'` that the descent-cocycle reassembly of E3 forms. -/
theorem isAffineOpen_inf {V W : (XA).Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) :
    IsAffineOpen (V ⊓ W) :=
  hV.inf hW
